rationale: The buyers are Salesforce admins and developers at mid-market and enterprise companies — a specific, budget-holding professional audience that already pays significant Salesforce license fees and routinely buys third-party tooling (AppExchange ecosystem). The pain is genuine: silent data-sync failures in Data Cloud waste hours of debugging with no native diagnostics. A Claude-powered diagnostic assistant (a guided troubleshooting workflow + document analysis tool) is buildable within this factory's standard tooling. The limiting factor is signal strength: this is a single forum post, not a validated demand cluster, so validate before committing to build.
solution_plan: WHAT: A Salesforce Data Cloud Diagnostic Assistant — a web-based guided troubleshooting tool that walks admins through Data Cloud configuration issues (DLO sync, Data Transform, data stream health) and surfaces the most likely root cause. BUILD: The factory builds a Claude prompt that ingests a user's configuration description or error log and returns a structured diagnostic report with ranked hypotheses and next steps; this is wrapped in a simple intake form + landing page, with a one-time payment via Stripe ($49–$99 per diagnostic session or $29/mo for unlimited). SELL: Reach Salesforce admins via LinkedIn (search 'Salesforce Data Cloud' + 'Admin' or 'Architect'), Salesforce Trailblazer Community posts, and targeted replies on Salesforce Stack Exchange threads — outreach batches go out only after operator approval. MAINTAIN: Users submit their config details via the intake form; Claude generates the diagnostic report automatically and emails it; billing is Stripe self-serve; support is a Claude-powered FAQ reply bot. The only recurring human touch is approving outreach batches. Caveat: validate demand with 10–15 direct cold messages before building the full page.
notes: Passes all build_gates on scores alone (operational_autonomy=6 meets floor of 7? No — operational_autonomy=6 is below the floor of 7, so build_gate fails). Correctly staged at validate.
